profile.name: David Idemudia Odigie
profile.headline: Cybersecurity Analyst | SOC & Threat Intelligence Specialist

summary: Cybersecurity Analyst and Threat Intelligence Specialist with hands-on experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment at GTCO, one of Nigeria's leading financial institutions. Manages enterprise-grade security tooling, threat hunting, policy development, and subsidiary security deployments across a multi-entity estate. Combines network security, endpoint detection, and SIEM operations experience with automation capability, building custom Python tooling and platforms that measurably reduce analyst effort. Strong Computer Science background with a focus on proactive defence, intelligence-led security, and scalable security solutions.

experience.title: Cybersecurity Analyst & Threat Intelligence Specialist
highlights: Operate within the Security Operations Centre (SOC), monitoring enterprise environments across parent and subsidiary entities for indicators of compromise, anomalous behaviour, and policy violations.
Develop, review, and enforce security policies, access control rules, and detection logic across QRadar SIEM, Cortex XDR, and Palo Alto NGFW.
Lead the enterprise CIMTrak File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) deployment for the parent subsidiary, scoping assets, configuring agents, defining baselines, and generating integrity reports.
Conduct proactive threat hunting using Darktrace NDR and Cortex XDR telemetry, identifying advanced threats and lateral movement before escalation.
Author threat intelligence advisories, vulnerability bulletins, and security alerts for technical and executive stakeholders; maintain threat actor and TTP tracking aligned to MITRE ATT&CK.
Plan and execute security assessments across network, endpoint, and identity layers, producing findings reports with prioritised remediation guidance.
Manage security tool deployments and integrations for subsidiaries, including Forescout NAC onboarding, Forcepoint DLP policy configuration, and CheckPoint Email Security rule management.
Administer Active Directory environments and support network administration including VLAN segmentation, firewall rule management via Palo Alto NGFW and AlgoSec, and traffic analysis using IXIA.
Built and maintain a Python-based SOC toolkit for log parsing, IOC extraction, alert triage, and operational reporting, reducing manual analyst effort.
Developed a threat intelligence platform integrating advisory management, threat hunt workflows, and logging to support the full intelligence lifecycle.
Built SyncGlide, a collaborative synchronisation dashboard, and a team task tracker used across the SOC for structured incident and task management.
Automate workflows using Python and Cortex XSOAR scripting to orchestrate playbook actions, enrich alert context, and remove repetitive SOC tasks.

experience.title: Head of Computer Department
highlights: Designed and implemented a structured ICT curriculum aligned with national education standards and industry best practice.
Mentored students in programming fundamentals, web development, and digital literacy.
Collaborated with school leadership and external partners to integrate emerging technologies into classroom learning.

experience.title: Software Development Intern
highlights: Assisted senior developers in the design and development of software applications across the full development lifecycle.
Applied version control best practice using Git and GitHub for collaborative project management.
Contributed to graphic design and multimedia editing initiatives, broadening cross-functional skills.
